notes:
Context: mid-market product analytics vendor; built-in conversational assistant and doc search for customer success and onboarding. Ran 2-week Hosted API trial (Jan 28–Feb 11). Interested in Dedicated for predictable latency and cost at scale.

Hosted trial highlights (raw): 120k requests/day average during trial week, baseline QPS ~6.5, peak sustained QPS observed 18 (approx 18:34 UTC spike on 2026-02-02), median concurrency ~8, 95th concurrency ~22 during peak. Token mix: avg tokens/request 420 (prompt ~130, completion ~290). Usage distribution: 65% chat/support-agent, 25% doc-search/embeddings (batch re-rank), 10% summarization/batch jobs.

SLOs/reqs: target p95 latency < 250ms for short chat turns (<=128 tokens), overall p95 generation < 800ms for longer completions; throughput target initially 15 QPS sustained with headroom for 3x spikes for seasonal events. Cost sensitivity: high — CFO wants unit economics visibility and controls (per-token chargeback).

Model preferences & routing: prefer open Llama/Redwood-verified variants for cost but need fallback to higher-quality model for escalations. Want model pinning and automated fallback to cheaper variant when load > capacity. Prefix/KV caching for repeated context recommended.

Security & compliance: must pass SOC2 type II and SSO/SAML, require audit logs + KMS integration for keys, data residency preference for NA only. Legal asks for retention controls and ability to delete PII on request.

POC notes: SE Jordan ran two canary flows—baseline vs cached KV enabled. Caching reduced token spend per conversation ~18%. SE recommended batching for embeddings pipelines (nightly re-rank with large token counts).

Quote from Head of Platform: "Quality must not regress — we will tolerate a small delta for cost savings, but we need regression alerts tied to eval prompts."

Current ask: Dedicated capacity sizing worksheet (attached), forecast by QPS/concurrency/token mix, expected monthly spend at 3 sizing tiers (baseline, growth x2, growth x5), and pricing for reserved capacity + burst. Also request an on-site security review (vpc network diagram + KMS flow).
